title: Chat box avatar/name sizing updates and extend availability time dropdown to 8am–9pm

requirements.text: Increase the chat box (and only the chat box) message header sizing so that each message shows a 25px x 25px profile picture and a 14px display name, without changing avatar/name sizing anywhere else in the app.

quotes: Also can we increase display name to 14px and have the profile picture be 25px by 25px.

acceptanceCriteria: In the chat message list (frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.tsx), each message renders the sender avatar at exactly 25x25 pixels.
In the chat message list, the sender display name renders at 14px font size.
Avatar/name sizing in other areas that use AvatarName (e.g., day detail page and any other pages/components) remains unchanged from current behavior.

requirements.text: Update the availability start-time dropdown options to span 8:00 AM through 9:00 PM (inclusive).
acceptanceCriteria: On the Add/Edit Availability page (frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.tsx), the selectable TIME_OPTIONS start at "8:00 AM" and end at "9:00 PM".
Times earlier than 8:00 AM and later than 9:00 PM are not shown as normal dropdown options.
If an existing availability has a legacy time value outside the new range, that value still appears as a selectable "(legacy)" option, and the form can be saved without losing it.

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any sources under frontend/src/components/ui).
Keep backend as single-actor Motoko; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not change global avatar sizing rules for AvatarName across the entire app.
Do not change the backend availability data model or how availability times are stored; only adjust the frontend dropdown options.
